newsitem.title: UK: General Accident sees better Q1 figures.
newsitem.headline: General Accident sees better Q1 figures.

text.p: General Accident Plc said on Wednesday that favourable winter weather conditions in the UK and North America would see it posting "much improved" first quarter results compared with the year-ago period.

Addressing shareholders at the annual meeting, chairman Lord Arlie said; "This year I am pleased to say that the winter weather has been much more favourable and therefore the first quarter figures for 1997...will show a much improved trading result over 1996".
General Accident is due to announce its first quarter figures on May 13.
General Accident saw its pre-tax operating profit dipping to 55 million stg from 112 million in the first quarter in 1996 after weather claims cost it 70 million stg.
